items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Billy Douglas. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, he's still alive. I don't know the last I heard he was in the town. Oh, no. He's out now. He is in jail.

ctx.x: I just wonder, because so many people arrange at the piano and... Most of them do.

Well, we had another one like all that didn't use the piano. He might know anything about the piano. It's for Billy Douglas to sound like the whole arrangement out of his head. He couldn't touch any history. What about the... Yeah, it is.
We can continue. Did you have any trouble with transposition or anything? No. I mean for the various instruments.
